newsitem.title: USA: TSX Corp chairman offers 300,000 shares.
newsitem.headline: TSX Corp chairman offers 300,000 shares.

text.p: TSX Corp said Monday in a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission that William Lambert, its chairman, president and chief executive officer has offered up to 300,000 common shares.
In the filing, TSX said the shares offered by Lambert are issuable upon the exercise options granted to him as part of a March 14, 1994 stock option agreement.
Lambert also owns directly 3,000 common shares and benefically owns an additional 300,000 common shares which are issuable to him upon his exercise of additional options granted under the agreement.
After the offering there will be 15,423,666 common shares outstanding, the filing said.
